## Brand & Style

This design system delivers a tactile, modern culinary atmosphere geared toward discerning diners and streamlined digital ordering. The aesthetic blends culinary warmth with architectural minimalism, stripping away visual clutter to elevate high-resolution food imagery and transparent ingredient stories.

- **Personality**: Curated, appetizing, grounded, effortless, and hospitable.
- **Audience**: Modern consumers seeking artisanal food & drink ordering with friction-free customization, transparent cart tallies, and prompt checkout clarity.
- **Visual Aesthetic**: A synthesis of Warm Minimalism and Tactile Depth. Layouts deploy generous cream surfaces, rich espresso anchoring typography, fine low-contrast borders, and focused terracotta-amber interactive drivers to evoke the sensory warmth of craft kitchens and espresso bars.

## Colors

The color palette centers on warm culinary tones contrasted against deep roast darks and crisp, inviting neutral surfaces:

- **Primary (`#E25C2B`)**: Warm terracotta and amber orange. Directs primary calls-to-action, key price highlights, quantity stepper additions, and active navigational tab markers.
- **Secondary (`#1F1B18`)**: Deep roast espresso. Used for primary headlines, structural containers, high-contrast badges, and primary text clarity across lighter cards.
- **Tertiary (`#10B981`)**: Vivid emerald green. Reserved for success badges, dietary labels (e.g., vegan, organic), order status confirmation, and prep timeline progression.
- **Neutral (`#6B7280`)**: Muted slate gray. Defines secondary body details, subheadings, subtle metadata labels, stepper borders, and structural partition strokes.
- **Canvas & Surfaces**: Base canvas utilizes `#F3EFEA` (warm linen tint) paired with pristine `#F9F7F4` (crisp cream) for modular food cards, order panels, and floating drawers.

## Typography

The type scale runs exclusively on **Plus Jakarta Sans**, balancing warm geometry with crisp legibility across digital menu hierarchies. 

- **Display & Headlines**: Tightly tracked (`-0.02em` to `-0.01em`) with weights from Semibold (600) to ExtraBold (800) to create appetizing culinary impact and clear section boundaries.
- **Body**: Regular (400) weight tuned with open line spacing (1.5x to 1.6x) for effortless scanning of menu descriptions, dietary notes, and customization breakdowns.
- **Labels & Numbers**: Semibold (600) and Medium (500) weights optimize numeric display across pricing arrays, quantity stepper digits, and receipt breakdowns.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout is built around a structured 12-column desktop grid with a maximum content canvas of 1440px, anchored by an asymmetrical split between menu discovery (8 columns) and the real-time order drawer / summary (4 columns).

- **Grid & Gutters**: Desktop uses a 1.5rem (`24px`) gutter and a 2.5rem (`40px`) outer canvas margin to ensure generous breathing room around visual cards.
- **Spacing Rhythm**: Standard increments scale from `0.25rem` (`4px`) up to `2.5rem` (`40px`), governing macro card gaps and micro stepper/button internal paddings.
- **Sticky Order Rail**: The receipt/order summary docks along the right side of the desktop viewport at 380px–420px width, remaining fixed while the primary menu content scrolls smoothly beneath sticky culinary category filters.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual hierarchy leverages crisp card boundaries balanced with warm ambient diffusion to lift interactive layers off the linen background:

- **Level 0 (Canvas Base)**: `#F3EFEA` solid surface, zero elevation.
- **Level 1 (Card & Content Blocks)**: `#F9F7F4` surfaces framed by a subtle 1px border (`rgba(107, 114, 128, 0.16)`), elevated with `0 2px 8px -2px rgba(31, 27, 24, 0.04)`.
- **Level 2 (Hover States & Stepper Units)**: Active menu cards elevate on hover with `0 8px 24px -4px rgba(31, 27, 24, 0.08)`, gently translating -2px on the Y-axis.
- **Level 3 (Sticky Order Bar & Modals)**: Floated receipts, sticky bottom panels, and item customization dialogs feature deep ambient shadows: `0 16px 40px -8px rgba(31, 27, 24, 0.12)`, bordered by `rgba(107, 114, 128, 0.12)`.

## Shapes

The design system employs a refined `Rounded` (`0.5rem` base, up to `1rem` on container cards) architecture:

- **Base Controls (`rounded-md` / 0.5rem)**: Quantity steppers, filter tags, text inputs, and inline action buttons.
- **Cards & Surfaces (`rounded-lg` / 1.0rem)**: Menu food item cards, floating order receipt panels, and category navigation headers.
- **Pills & Status (`rounded-full`)**: Success confirmations, active category pills, dietary tags, and stepper minus/plus circular touchpoints.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary**: Solid terracotta orange (`#E25C2B`), white label (`#FFFFFF`), `0.5rem` radius, minimum desktop height `44px` (touch-target generous `48px` on order summaries). Hover transitions smoothly to `#CF4E1E`.
- **Secondary**: Rich espresso outline or solid espresso (`#1F1B18`) for high-contrast actions (e.g., "Checkout Now"), text styled in `#FFFFFF` with tracking `0.01em`.
- **Ghost/Tertiary**: Slate gray text (`#6B7280`) with soft cream hover background (`rgba(31, 27, 24, 0.05)`).

### Quantity Stepper Controls
- Engineered with high touch target clarity: paired minus/plus icon buttons (`32px × 32px` or `36px × 36px`) housed in a shared pill or rounded container bordered with `rgba(107, 114, 128, 0.24)`.
- Minus icon shifts to a trash icon when quantity equals 1. Center quantity label is set in Plus Jakarta Sans Semibold with fixed tabular numerals to prevent layout shift during updates.

### Cards
- **Menu Item Cards**: Grounded in crisp cream (`#F9F7F4`), bordered by 1px slate tint. Image rests either along the top (16:10 aspect ratio) or right-aligned square (`120px × 120px`). Bottom row neatly splits bold price (`#1F1B18`) and quick-add terracotta stepper.
- **Selected State**: Outlined with an active 1.5px `#E25C2B` highlight and soft terracotta shadow tint.

### Chips & Badges
- **Dietary & Category Chips**: Outlined with `rgba(107, 114, 128, 0.2)` with neutral text; active state fills with espresso `#1F1B18` and crisp cream text `#F9F7F4`.
- **Confirmed & Success Badges**: Emerald green (`#10B981`) text over a fresh tinted surface (`rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12)`), paired with a solid 6px emerald status dot.

### Form Inputs & Checkboxes
- **Input Fields**: Crisp cream fill `#F9F7F4`, 1px border `#6B7280` at 30% opacity, focusing to an authoritative terracotta ring (`#E25C2B` at 2px outer glow).
- **Modifiers & Add-ons**: Checkboxes and radios display custom rounded-md and rounded-full indicators with terracotta fill upon selection, paired with item cost additions aligned flush to the right margin.

### Sticky Order Bar & Receipt Drawer
- **Structure**: Clean modular slip styling. Features dashed divider lines (`border-dashed border-gray-300`), itemized customization trees in muted slate (`#6B7280`), and explicit subtotal/tax/tip rows.
- **Totals**: Displayed in Display/Headline typography in espresso `#1F1B18` above a full-width sticky `#E25C2B` checkout trigger button.","version":1,"identity":{"name":"Modern Culinary App"}}

## Typography

The type scale runs exclusively on **Plus Jakarta Sans**, balancing warm geometry with crisp legibility across digital menu hierarchies. 

- **Display & Headlines**: Tightly tracked (`-0.02em` to `-0.01em`) with weights from Semibold (600) to ExtraBold (800) to create appetizing culinary impact and clear section boundaries.
- **Body**: Regular (400) weight tuned with open line spacing (1.5x to 1.6x) for effortless scanning of menu descriptions, dietary notes, and customization breakdowns.
- **Labels & Numbers**: Semibold (600) and Medium (500) weights optimize numeric display across pricing arrays, quantity stepper digits, and receipt breakdowns.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout is built around a structured 12-column desktop grid with a maximum content canvas of 1440px, anchored by an asymmetrical split between menu discovery (8 columns) and the real-time order drawer / summary (4 columns).

- **Grid & Gutters**: Desktop uses a 1.5rem (`24px`) gutter and a 2.5rem (`40px`) outer canvas margin to ensure generous breathing room around visual cards.
- **Spacing Rhythm**: Standard increments scale from `0.25rem` (`4px`) up to `2.5rem` (`40px`), governing macro card gaps and micro stepper/button internal paddings.
- **Sticky Order Rail**: The receipt/order summary docks along the right side of the desktop viewport at 380px–420px width, remaining fixed while the primary menu content scrolls smoothly beneath sticky culinary category filters.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual hierarchy leverages crisp card boundaries balanced with warm ambient diffusion to lift interactive layers off the linen background:

- **Level 0 (Canvas Base)**: `#F3EFEA` solid surface, zero elevation.
- **Level 1 (Card & Content Blocks)**: `#F9F7F4` surfaces framed by a subtle 1px border (`rgba(107, 114, 128, 0.16)`), elevated with `0 2px 8px -2px rgba(31, 27, 24, 0.04)`.
- **Level 2 (Hover States & Stepper Units)**: Active menu cards elevate on hover with `0 8px 24px -4px rgba(31, 27, 24, 0.08)`, gently translating -2px on the Y-axis.
- **Level 3 (Sticky Order Bar & Modals)**: Floated receipts, sticky bottom panels, and item customization dialogs feature deep ambient shadows: `0 16px 40px -8px rgba(31, 27, 24, 0.12)`, bordered by `rgba(107, 114, 128, 0.12)`.

## Shapes

The design system employs a refined `Rounded` (`0.5rem` base, up to `1rem` on container cards) architecture:

- **Base Controls (`rounded-md` / 0.5rem)**: Quantity steppers, filter tags, text inputs, and inline action buttons.
- **Cards & Surfaces (`rounded-lg` / 1.0rem)**: Menu food item cards, floating order receipt panels, and category navigation headers.
- **Pills & Status (`rounded-full`)**: Success confirmations, active category pills, dietary tags, and stepper minus/plus circular touchpoints.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary**: Solid terracotta orange (`#E25C2B`), white label (`#FFFFFF`), `0.5rem` radius, minimum desktop height `44px` (touch-target generous `48px` on order summaries). Hover transitions smoothly to `#CF4E1E`.
- **Secondary**: Rich espresso outline or solid espresso (`#1F1B18`) for high-contrast actions (e.g., "Checkout Now"), text styled in `#FFFFFF` with tracking `0.01em`.
- **Ghost/Tertiary**: Slate gray text (`#6B7280`) with soft cream hover background (`rgba(31, 27, 24, 0.05)`).

### Quantity Stepper Controls
- Engineered with high touch target clarity: paired minus/plus icon buttons (`32px × 32px` or `36px × 36px`) housed in a shared pill or rounded container bordered with `rgba(107, 114, 128, 0.24)`.
- Minus icon shifts to a trash icon when quantity equals 1. Center quantity label is set in Plus Jakarta Sans Semibold with fixed tabular numerals to prevent layout shift during updates.

### Cards
- **Menu Item Cards**: Grounded in crisp cream (`#F9F7F4`), bordered by 1px slate tint. Image rests either along the top (16:10 aspect ratio) or right-aligned square (`120px × 120px`). Bottom row neatly splits bold price (`#1F1B18`) and quick-add terracotta stepper.
- **Selected State**: Outlined with an active 1.5px `#E25C2B` highlight and soft terracotta shadow tint.

### Chips & Badges
- **Dietary & Category Chips**: Outlined with `rgba(107, 114, 128, 0.2)` with neutral text; active state fills with espresso `#1F1B18` and crisp cream text `#F9F7F4`.
- **Confirmed & Success Badges**: Emerald green (`#10B981`) text over a fresh tinted surface (`rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12)`), paired with a solid 6px emerald status dot.

### Form Inputs & Checkboxes
- **Input Fields**: Crisp cream fill `#F9F7F4`, 1px border `#6B7280` at 30% opacity, focusing to an authoritative terracotta ring (`#E25C2B` at 2px outer glow).
- **Modifiers & Add-ons**: Checkboxes and radios display custom rounded-md and rounded-full indicators with terracotta fill upon selection, paired with item cost additions aligned flush to the right margin.

### Sticky Order Bar & Receipt Drawer
- **Structure**: Clean modular slip styling. Features dashed divider lines (`border-dashed border-gray-300`), itemized customization trees in muted slate (`#6B7280`), and explicit subtotal/tax/tip rows.
- **Totals**: Displayed in Display/Headline typography in espresso `#1F1B18` above a full-width sticky `#E25C2B` checkout trigger button.
